why_how.text: Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. At a red light, stop behind the crosswalk or stop line. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A right turn on red is allowed only after stopping and yielding to people and other vehicles, unless a sign prohibits it. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A left turn on red from a one-way street to another one-way street is permitted after stopping and yielding. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. At an amber light, stop before entering the intersection if that can be done safely; otherwise proceed carefully. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A green light permits entering only when the way is clear, while yielding to people and vehicles already in the intersection. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A flashing red signal requires a complete stop before the intersection and has the same meaning as a stop sign. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A flashing amber signal requires caution at the warned hazardous intersection or location. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A red arrow prohibits turning in the direction it points. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. An amber arrow may follow a green arrow and warns drivers to clear the intersection. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.

Apply the stated scope before choosing an action. A green arrow permits turning in its direction without stopping when the path is clear, but drivers must yield to people and other traffic already inside the intersection. The person, condition, amount and exception named in this rule stay together when it is used.
